description.en: EN: Ontology for representing medical devices, manufacturers, risks, incidents and field safety corrective actions under MDR and IVDR.

comments.en: This ontology models a European-style catalogue of medical devices, manufacturers, IMDRF risks, reported incidents and field safety corrective actions. It is designed as an application ontology for the PEC2 assignment.
